content.short: Topper is a fiat onramp by Uphold for buying and selling 200+ cryptocurrencies to self-custody wallets.
content.description: Topper is Uphold's onramp product, letting users buy and sell more than two hundred assets directly to and from wallets they control. Monad's documentation lists it among onramp providers. Being backed by an established exchange gives it the licensing and banking relationships that are the hard part of this business, rather than the checkout interface itself.
